name: AI & Automation
description: AI tools, chatbots, LLMs, agents, AI coding, image/video generation, voice/music AI, prompts, and automation workflows.

tree.name: AI
tree.description: Artificial intelligence tools, models, automation workflows, generative media, agents, and practical AI use cases.

profile.summary: Use when AI or automation is the primary reason to save the material: AI services, LLMs, chatbots, agents, coding assistants, prompt packs, generative media, AI news, or practical AI workflows. Do not use only because the item mentions AI casually.
negative_examples: Regular software tool with no AI behavior.
Movie release news unrelated to AI.

children.name: LLM & Chatbots
children.description: ChatGPT-like assistants, language models, chat interfaces, structured output, tool calling, and text reasoning.

profile.summary: Use for language-model and chatbot material: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, local LLMs, prompts for text reasoning, structured output, tool calling, and LLM behavior. If the main topic is coding automation, use AI Coding.
negative_examples: AI image generator with no text assistant angle.

children.name: AI Coding
children.description: Coding assistants, vibe coding, code agents, repository generators, IDE copilots, and AI-assisted software workflows.

profile.summary: Use for AI-assisted programming: coding agents, vibe coding, IDE assistants, code generation, repository automation, AI debugging, and tools where AI writes or changes code.
positive_examples: AI agent that builds apps from prompts.

children.name: AI Agents
children.description: Agentic workflows, planners, tools, memory, autonomous tasks, multi-step automation, and AI operators.

profile.summary: Use for agentic AI systems: planner/executor loops, tool use, memory, autonomous tasks, multi-step automation, approvals, and AI operators. A single prompt or simple chatbot is not enough.
negative_examples: Generic job queue without AI decision-making.

children.name: Image & Video AI
children.description: AI image generation, video generation, 3D generation, visual editing, model releases, and generative visual tools.

profile.summary: Use for visual generative AI: image generation, video generation, visual editing, 3D model generation, generative design tools, and releases of visual AI models.
negative_examples: UI reference with no AI generation.

children.name: Voice & Music AI
children.description: Voice cloning, speech tools, AI music, audio generation, transcription, dubbing, and voice interfaces.

profile.summary: Use for AI audio: voice cloning, speech generation, music generation, transcription, dubbing, voice input, and audio model tools.
positive_examples: Open source voice input powered by AI.

children.name: Prompts & Workflows
children.description: Prompt packs, prompt engineering, reusable AI workflows, templates, system prompts, and AI task recipes.

profile.summary: Use for reusable prompt and workflow material: prompt packs, system prompts, prompt engineering, templates, chains, task recipes, and practical AI workflows.
positive_examples: Reusable prompt workflow for text cleanup.
negative_examples: AI model news with no prompt workflow.
